finding: The communicate(input=program) exception path records io_error, then directly calls child.wait() without first closing the still-owned stdin. An input IO exception before EOF can leave the original remote python3 process waiting for more script bytes while its owner waits for exit; no terminal receipt can then be produced.
evidence_kind: Actual frozen source exception/lifetime path. No device hang or runtime occurrence is claimed.
minimal_resolution: Preserve R1. Close this original Popen's still-open stdin before waiting the same child in finally. Preserve close/wait/log/terminal errors as failed or unknown evidence; no kill, retry, new child or changed dispatch.
other_reviewed_new_boundaries: preflight releases only its own service flock fd before spawning or execing pinned worker
qualified quiesce requires original supervisor and child terminal-zero identities plus actual state/summary/boot originals
restart remains once intent and unproved dispatch; seven-raw export retains stage source and context hashes
unknown mutation remains consumed and status/fetch reads originals without replay
